transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the greenlight meeting today to review the proposed license deal with the international airline for the concert documentary. Before I can sign off on the final license terms and delivery instructions, I need each of you — rights, music, and post-production leads — to report any approval conditions or outstanding items on your end. Please go ahead and share your updates so we can work through any conditions and get this closed today.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a significant issue before we proceed. Yesterday I reviewed the executed performer agreements, and they constrain this deal substantially. The documentary may be licensed only in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom — not worldwide as the buyer's draft proposes. The term is limited to six months non-exclusive, not twelve months. And critically, the performer agreements require a written rights amendment before we can deliver. The buyer's draft package arrived after I completed my review, so these constraints have not yet been reflected in the proposed terms. We cannot greenlight this deal as currently drafted.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a music clearance condition to report. I checked the publisher's clearance ledger this morning and confirmed that the current cut's use of the song 'Afterglow Avenue' lacks the synchronization clearance required for airline distribution. The cleared replacement is 'Night Transit,' and I have not yet updated the music cue sheet because the final territory and term were still unsettled. Now that the territory and term are being narrowed per Jonah's constraints, I can update the cue sheet with 'Night Transit' as the replacement, but that swap needs to be completed and delivered before we can greenlight.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a post-production delivery condition to report. Today I completed the airline's ingest test with the delivery vendor and confirmed that the required delivery master is 1080p SDR video with stereo Lt/Rt audio and English SDH captions as a sidecar VTT file. Our current master is 4K with a different audio and caption package, so I need to issue a revised export order to produce the correct master. I have not yet issued that revised export order because the licensing terms were still pending. This new export will need to be completed before we can deliver.
